SELECT TOP 20 ba.AccountNo, ba.Balance AS CurrentBalance, bab.Balance AS HistoricalBalance
FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] ba
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT b1.BankAccountRef, b1.Balance
    FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] b1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT BankAccountRef, MAX(FiscalYearRef) AS MaxFiscalYear
        FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance]
        GROUP BY BankAccountRef
    ) b2 ON b1.BankAccountRef = b2.BankAccountRef AND b1.FiscalYearRef = b2.MaxFiscalYear
) bab ON ba.BankAccountId = bab.BankAccountRef
ORDER BY ba.AccountNo ASC
final_sql:

FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] ba
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT b1.BankAccountRef, b1.Balance
    FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] b1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT BankAccountRef, MAX(FiscalYearRef) AS MaxFiscalYear
        FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance]
        GROUP BY BankAccountRef
    ) b2 ON b1.BankAccountRef = b2.BankAccountRef AND b1.FiscalYearRef = b2.MaxFiscalYear
) bab ON ba.BankAccountId = bab.BankAccountRef
ORDER BY ba.AccountNo ASC
